# Odonto Template — Preparation & Tasks

- **Source**: ColorLib Toothcare (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/toothcare/`)
- **Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/toothcare/`
- **New App Name**: `odonto` (`@free-react-templates/odonto`)
- **Design Tokens**:
  - Primary / Brand: Cyan / Teal (`#00bcd4` to `#65c4cf`)
  - Background: Light gray `#f8f9fa`, pure white `#ffffff`, dark footer `#1a252f`
  - Text: Dark slate `#212529`
  - Font: Poppins / Sans-serif

## Section Breakdown & Implementation Notes

1. **Navbar**: Fixed/sticky header with brand logo, nav links, and CTA button.
2. **Hero**: Full-width background with cyan gradient overlay, headline, and action buttons.
3. **Intro/Features Cards**: 3-column feature highlights with icons.
4. **About**: Two-column layout with image and introductory text about dental excellence.
5. **Services**: Grid of 6+ dental procedure cards with icons and hover states.
6. **Appointment**: Interactive form with date/time pickers and success state.
7. **Counters**: 3-4 statistic counters.
8. **Team**: Grid of dentist profiles with photos and social links.
9. **Testimonials**: Customer review cards.
10. **Blog**: Recent articles grid.
11. **CTA Banner**: Full-width banner urging immediate booking.
12. **Footer**: Multi-column footer with mandatory Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).
